status: Closed — branch commit orphan-recovery repair and sealed-runner delivery reverified on 2026-09-05
finding: Live reproduction of the ATM-GOV-0265 branch-commit-queue deadlock. A governed `atm git commit` whose pre-commit hook runs longer than the caller's timeout was killed (SIGTERM); it left its OWN branch-commit-queue lock (.atm/runtime/locks/git-commit-queue-refs-heads-main.lock) with ownerPid dead and headShaAtAcquire == current HEAD. Retrying failed with ATM_GIT_COMMIT_BRANCH_QUEUE_BUSY forever, because live self-heal only reclaims a stale lock when HEAD has moved (headMoved); a dead-pid, same-actor, same-HEAD lock is never reclaimed. The only remedy was owner-approved manual lock deletion, which dispatched agents are forbidden to perform.
expectedBehavior: Two mitigations: (1) The governed commit wrapper should install a SIGTERM/SIGINT cleanup handler that releases its own branch-commit-queue lock before exiting, so a timeout never orphans the queue. (2) Lock acquisition should reclaim a stale lock when the recorded ownerPid is confirmed dead AND actorId/sessionId match the requester, independent of headMoved — a dead process holding its own lock is never a real concurrent writer.
evidenceOrRepro: Task TASK-SKL-0029, actor claude-004-skl-0029-captain. First `atm git commit --auto-stage` hit a 2-minute timeout mid pre-commit-hook (exit 143). Orphan lock record.json: ownerPid 68528 (verified dead via ps), headShaAtAcquire 185a39d035c2a3d33d7fa72ad8793fbb9f697f5e == HEAD. Retry (even with --timeout-ms 540000) returned ATM_GIT_COMMIT_BRANCH_QUEUE_BUSY, headShaCurrent == headShaAtAcquire, retryable:true but permanently stuck. Recovered only via one-time owner-approved Remove-Item of the lock dir. Cross-ref ATM-GOV-0265. Current source evidence: `node --strip-types tests/cli/branch-commit-window-stale-lock.test.ts` passes dead-PID, unchanged-HEAD reclaim after the safety window; `node --strip-types tests/cli/branch-commit-orphan-recovery.test.ts` passes fenced orphan recovery without manual `.atm/runtime` deletion.
followUp: Source repair is verified by branch-commit-window-stale-lock and branch-commit-orphan-recovery regressions, with the repair included in the current sealed runner lineage. Commit timeout tuning remains a separate performance concern and does not reopen this dead-PID recovery defect.
